import json, subprocess, sys
# mixed batch: valid, invalid, valid-with-rejections, invalid
SVC = [{"name": "A", "label": 2}, {"name": "B", "label": 1}]
LIM = {"images": 2, "cells": 64, "units": 2, "contexts": 2, "connections": 2, "packets": 2, "files": 2}
jobs = [
    {"services": SVC, "limits": LIM, "events": [
        {"op": "stage", "epoch": 3, "policy": "match(A,B) allow;"},
        {"op": "commit", "epoch": 3},
        {"op": "spawn", "unit": [9, 9, 9], "service": "B"},
        {"op": "begin", "unit": [9, 9, 9], "rid": 4},
        {"op": "begin", "unit": [9, 9, 9], "rid": 2},   # mark -> reject
        {"op": "finish", "unit": [9, 9, 9], "rid": 4},
    ]},
    {"services": [], "limits": {}, "events": []},       # invalid
    {"services": SVC, "limits": LIM, "events": [
        {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "match(A,B) allow;"},
        {"op": "spawn", "unit": [1, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
        {"op": "spawn", "unit": [1, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    ]},
    {"services": SVC, "limits": dict(LIM, images=0), "events": []},  # invalid
]
raw = json.dumps({"jobs": jobs}).encode()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/launch.py'], input=raw,
                   capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
out = p.stdout.decode()
print(out)
r = json.loads(out)
assert set(r) == {"results"} and len(r["results"]) == 4
assert r["results"][1] == {"error": "invalid"} and r["results"][3] == {"error": "invalid"}
assert r["results"][0]["events"][4] == {"error": "rejected"}
assert r["results"][2]["events"][2] == {"error": "rejected"}
assert p.stderr == b''
print("mixed batch OK")
EOF
